newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil eases in moribund market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil eases in moribund market.

text.p: NWE gas oil eased in line with benchmark IPE futures in a typically quiet Monday market, traders said.
June IPE was 50 cents lower at $172.00 a tonne at 1200 GMT.

Heating oil barge premiums were talked at June IPE +$1.0/+$2.0 fob ARA for first half June delivery and running refinery barges traded at June IPE $1.0 and $1.25 fob Rotterdam for first half June delivery.
Low sulphur was talked at June IPE +$8.50/+$10 fob ARA and a 3,000 tonne barge traded at June IPE +$8.75 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Traders said the market was very quiet.
"It's a pretty average Monday," said one.
Some said that the dollar's strength against the mark and French franc following the Socialists' win in the French parliamentary election was also putting a dampener on the market.
At 1200 GMT, the dollar mark stood at 1.7233/43 against 1.7082/92 late on Friday.
"I think is just another factor keeping people on the sidelines," said one trader.
